description: Submit the wallet-signed MagicBlock challenge to log in and read the shielded USDC balance. Private bearer tokens never leave the backend. This is not permission to spend; checkout needs a separate wallet-signed transaction.

inputSchema.description: Login to MagicBlock with the signed challenge and read shielded USDC, without returning a bearer token. Never pay or broadcast; a transaction requires separate authorization.

challenge.description: Challenge issued for this wallet by privatepay_wallet_challenge.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the challenge message, signed locally by this wallet.

name: privatepay_private_balance

outputSchema.description: Authenticated shielded USDC balance and transaction-signing boundary.

title: PrivatePAY Authenticated Shielded USDC Balance
